frameworks.name: Risk-Based Cybersecurity Framework and Guidelines for Deposit Money Banks and Payment Service Providers

clauses.title: Board and senior management oversight
clauses.requirementText: The board approves the cybersecurity strategy and policy, and senior management reports cyber risk to it periodically.

clauses.title: Chief Information Security Officer function
clauses.requirementText: Appoint a CISO with adequate authority and independence from IT operations, reporting to senior management.

clauses.title: Cybersecurity risk assessment
clauses.requirementText: Identify, assess and treat cyber risks to information assets at least annually and on material change.

clauses.title: Access control
clauses.requirementText: Grant access on least privilege and need-to-know; review user access periodically and remove dormant or orphaned accounts promptly.

clauses.title: Privileged access management
clauses.requirementText: Restrict, approve, monitor and periodically recertify privileged and administrative accounts.

clauses.title: Vulnerability management
clauses.requirementText: Scan systems for vulnerabilities regularly, prioritise by risk and remediate within defined timelines; track exceptions.

clauses.title: Secure configuration baselines
clauses.requirementText: Define hardening baselines for servers, network devices and databases and audit deviations periodically.

clauses.title: Cyber incident reporting to CBN
clauses.requirementText: Report significant cyber incidents to the CBN within 24 hours of detection, followed by a full incident report.
clauses.deadlineRule: Initial report within 24 hours from detection — verify against the current circular

clauses.title: Incident response plan
clauses.requirementText: Maintain and test a documented cyber incident response plan with defined roles, escalation and communication.

clauses.title: Security logging and monitoring
clauses.requirementText: Log security-relevant events, retain logs for an adequate period, and review them for anomalous or privileged activity.

clauses.title: Third-party and outsourcing risk
clauses.requirementText: Assess the security posture of service providers before onboarding and periodically; include security obligations in contracts.

clauses.title: Cyber resilience and recovery
clauses.requirementText: Maintain backups and recovery capability for critical systems and test restoration periodically.

clauses.title: Cryptography and key management
clauses.requirementText: Protect sensitive data in transit and at rest with approved encryption and manage cryptographic keys securely through their lifecycle.

clauses.title: Change management
clauses.requirementText: Assess, approve, test and document changes to production systems, including emergency changes.

clauses.title: Annual self-assessment
clauses.requirementText: Perform a periodic self-assessment of compliance with the framework and report results to the board and CBN.
clauses.deadlineRule: Annual self-assessment submission — verify against the current circular

frameworks.name: Risk-Based Cybersecurity Framework and Guidelines for Other Financial Institutions

clauses.title: Board and senior management oversight
clauses.requirementText: The board approves the cybersecurity strategy and policy, and senior management reports cyber risk to it periodically.

clauses.title: Chief Information Security Officer function
clauses.requirementText: Appoint a CISO (or equivalent, proportionate to institution size) independent of IT operations, with a clear mandate and reporting line.

clauses.title: Cybersecurity risk assessment
clauses.requirementText: Identify, assess and treat cyber risks to information assets at least annually and on material change.

clauses.title: Access control
clauses.requirementText: Grant access on least privilege and need-to-know; review user access periodically and remove dormant or orphaned accounts promptly.

clauses.title: Privileged access management
clauses.requirementText: Restrict, approve, monitor and periodically recertify privileged and administrative accounts.

clauses.title: Vulnerability management
clauses.requirementText: Scan systems for vulnerabilities regularly, prioritise by risk and remediate within defined timelines; track exceptions.

clauses.title: Secure configuration baselines
clauses.requirementText: Define hardening baselines for servers, network devices and databases and audit deviations periodically.

clauses.title: Cyber incident reporting to CBN
clauses.requirementText: Report significant cyber incidents to the CBN within 24 hours of detection, followed by a full incident report.
clauses.deadlineRule: Initial report within 24 hours from detection — verify against the current circular

clauses.title: Incident response plan
clauses.requirementText: Maintain and test a documented cyber incident response plan with defined roles, escalation and communication.

clauses.title: Security logging and monitoring
clauses.requirementText: Log security-relevant events, retain logs for an adequate period, and review them for anomalous or privileged activity.

clauses.title: Third-party and outsourcing risk
clauses.requirementText: Assess the security posture of service providers before onboarding and periodically; include security obligations in contracts.

clauses.title: Cyber resilience and recovery
clauses.requirementText: Maintain backups and recovery capability for critical systems and test restoration periodically.

clauses.title: Cryptography and key management
clauses.requirementText: Protect sensitive data in transit and at rest with approved encryption and manage cryptographic keys securely through their lifecycle.

clauses.title: Change management
clauses.requirementText: Assess, approve, test and document changes to production systems, including emergency changes.

clauses.title: Annual self-assessment
clauses.requirementText: Perform an annual cybersecurity self-assessment against the framework and submit it to the CBN.
clauses.deadlineRule: Annual self-assessment submission — verify against the current circular

clauses.title: IT governance
clauses.requirementText: Align IT strategy, standards and investment with business objectives under board oversight.

clauses.title: Configuration management
clauses.requirementText: Maintain approved configuration standards for infrastructure and audit compliance periodically.

clauses.title: Change management
clauses.requirementText: Control changes through request, impact assessment, approval, testing, implementation and post-implementation review; govern emergency changes.

clauses.title: Disaster recovery
clauses.requirementText: Maintain a tested disaster recovery capability for critical IT services.

clauses.title: IT operations and service management
clauses.requirementText: Operate IT services with documented procedures, capacity planning and service-level monitoring.

frameworks.name: Guidelines on Business Continuity Planning for Banks

clauses.title: Business continuity plan
clauses.requirementText: Maintain a board-approved BCP covering critical business functions and their dependencies.

clauses.title: Business impact analysis
clauses.requirementText: Perform a business impact analysis to set recovery time and recovery point objectives.

clauses.title: Backup and restoration testing
clauses.requirementText: Back up critical data off-site and test restoration regularly against recovery objectives.

clauses.title: DR drills
clauses.requirementText: Conduct disaster recovery drills at least annually and remediate gaps found.
clauses.deadlineRule: At least annually — verify against the current circular

clauses.title: Operational risk event classification
clauses.requirementText: Classify operational risk events, including cyber incidents, using a consistent taxonomy.

clauses.title: Loss event data capture
clauses.requirementText: Record operational loss events and near misses in a loss database for analysis and reporting.

clauses.title: Key risk indicators
clauses.requirementText: Define and monitor key risk indicators with escalation thresholds.

clauses.title: Suspicious transaction reporting
clauses.requirementText: File a suspicious transaction report with the NFIU promptly once suspicion is formed, irrespective of amount.
clauses.deadlineRule: STR to NFIU within 24 hours of forming suspicion — verify against the current circular

clauses.title: Currency transaction reporting
clauses.requirementText: Report cash transactions above the prescribed threshold to the NFIU.
clauses.deadlineRule: CTR within 7 days of the transaction — verify against the current circular

clauses.title: Reporting through goAML
clauses.requirementText: Submit regulatory reports to the NFIU through the goAML platform and retain submission references.

clauses.title: Customer due diligence
clauses.requirementText: Identify and verify customers and beneficial owners and apply enhanced due diligence to higher-risk relationships.

clauses.title: Sanctions screening
clauses.requirementText: Screen customers and transactions against applicable sanctions lists and act on matches without delay.

clauses.title: Record keeping
clauses.requirementText: Retain customer and transaction records for at least five years after the relationship or transaction ends.
clauses.deadlineRule: Retain records for 5 years — verify against the current circular

clauses.title: Compliance officer (MLRO)
clauses.requirementText: Designate a senior compliance officer responsible for AML/CFT reporting and decisions.

clauses.title: Complaint handling
clauses.requirementText: Acknowledge, investigate and resolve customer complaints within prescribed timelines and escalate unresolved complaints.

clauses.title: Customer data protection
clauses.requirementText: Protect customer information and use it only for disclosed purposes.

clauses.title: Disclosure and transparency
clauses.requirementText: Disclose terms, fees and risks to customers clearly before contracting.

frameworks.name: Prudential, e-FASS and FinA Returns Schedule

clauses.title: Timely submission of prudential returns
clauses.requirementText: Prepare and submit periodic prudential returns by the dates in the CBN returns calendar.
clauses.deadlineRule: Per the CBN returns calendar for each return — verify against the current circular

clauses.title: Accuracy and validation of returns
clauses.requirementText: Ensure returns are complete, accurate and reconciled to source records before submission.

clauses.title: Maker-checker and approval
clauses.requirementText: Apply segregated preparation, review and senior approval before submission.

clauses.title: Retention of submission evidence
clauses.requirementText: Retain submitted returns, supporting workings and acknowledgements for supervisory review.

clauses.title: Principles of personal data processing
clauses.requirementText: Process personal data lawfully, fairly, for specified purposes, minimally, accurately, for limited time and securely.

clauses.title: Lawful basis of processing
clauses.requirementText: Process personal data only where a lawful basis such as consent, contract or legal obligation applies.

clauses.title: Data privacy impact assessment
clauses.requirementText: Carry out a DPIA before processing likely to result in high risk to data subjects.

clauses.title: Data processors and sub-processors
clauses.requirementText: Engage processors only under written terms that ensure they protect personal data and assist the controller.

clauses.title: Data protection officer
clauses.requirementText: Designate a data protection officer with expert knowledge to advise on and monitor compliance.

clauses.title: Rights of a data subject — access and information
clauses.requirementText: On request, provide confirmation of processing, a copy of the personal data and related information, and rectify or erase it where applicable.
clauses.deadlineRule: Respond within the statutory period (commonly applied as 30 days) — verify against the current circular

clauses.title: Withdrawal of consent
clauses.requirementText: Allow data subjects to withdraw consent at any time as easily as it was given.

clauses.title: Right to object
clauses.requirementText: Honour objections to processing, including for direct marketing.

clauses.title: Automated decision-making
clauses.requirementText: Allow data subjects not to be subject to solely automated decisions with significant effect, subject to exceptions.

clauses.title: Data portability
clauses.requirementText: Provide personal data in a structured, machine-readable format and transmit it on request where applicable.

clauses.title: Security, integrity and confidentiality
clauses.requirementText: Implement appropriate technical and organisational measures, including encryption and access control, to secure personal data.

clauses.title: Personal data breach notification
clauses.requirementText: Notify the Commission within 72 hours of becoming aware of a breach likely to risk data subjects' rights, and inform data subjects without undue delay where risk is high.
clauses.deadlineRule: Notify NDPC within 72 hours from awareness — verify against the current circular

clauses.title: Governing principles of processing
clauses.requirementText: Process personal data for specific legitimate purposes, adequately, accurately and with appropriate security.

clauses.title: Data security
clauses.requirementText: Develop security measures to protect personal data, including firewalls, access control and encryption.

clauses.title: Rights of data subjects
clauses.requirementText: Provide data subjects with information and respond to requests regarding their personal data.

clauses.title: Data protection audit filing
clauses.requirementText: Conduct a data protection audit and file the summary with the regulator annually through a licensed DPCO.
clauses.deadlineRule: Annual audit filing by the regulator's deadline — verify against the current circular

frameworks.name: NDPA General Application and Implementation Directive

clauses.title: Compliance audit returns
clauses.requirementText: File periodic compliance audit returns according to the controller's data-processing tier.
clauses.deadlineRule: Annual compliance audit returns per tier — verify against the current circular

clauses.title: Breach management procedure
clauses.requirementText: Maintain a breach management procedure with timelines, notification templates and a breach register.

clauses.title: Data subject request handling
clauses.requirementText: Operate a documented process to receive, verify, log and respond to data subject requests.

clauses.title: DPIA methodology
clauses.requirementText: Use a documented methodology to conduct and record DPIAs for high-risk processing.

clauses.title: Data inventory and records of processing
clauses.requirementText: Maintain an inventory of personal data and records of processing activities.

frameworks.name: Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) Act 2015, as amended 2024
frameworks.issuer: Office of the National Security Adviser / ngCERT

clauses.title: Duty to report cyber threats and incidents
clauses.requirementText: Report cyber attacks, intrusions and disruptions affecting the institution's systems to the national CERT promptly.
clauses.deadlineRule: General reporting within 7 days; shorter for critical infrastructure — verify against the current circular

clauses.title: Records retention and protection
clauses.requirementText: Retain traffic data and subscriber information for the prescribed period and protect its confidentiality.

clauses.title: Critical national information infrastructure
clauses.requirementText: Apply additional protection and reporting duties to systems designated as critical national information infrastructure.

frameworks.name: Nigeria Cloud Computing Policy and NITDA Guidelines

clauses.title: Cloud adoption risk assessment
clauses.requirementText: Assess security, privacy and continuity risks before adopting cloud services.

clauses.title: Data residency
clauses.requirementText: Host and process data in line with applicable data classification and residency requirements.

clauses.title: Cloud exit and portability
clauses.requirementText: Plan for data portability and exit from cloud providers.

frameworks.name: SEC Nigeria Rules and Regulations (Capital Market Operators)

clauses.title: Periodic regulatory returns
clauses.requirementText: Submit periodic returns and reports to the Commission by prescribed dates.

clauses.title: Information security and cyber resilience
clauses.requirementText: Maintain cyber resilience controls proportionate to the operator's activities.

clauses.title: AML/CFT obligations
clauses.requirementText: Apply AML/CFT controls and reporting for capital market activities.

clauses.title: Corporate governance
clauses.requirementText: Maintain board-level oversight of risk and compliance.

clauses.title: Regulatory returns
clauses.requirementText: Submit periodic returns to the Commission accurately and on time.

clauses.title: Information technology risk
clauses.requirementText: Manage IT and cyber risk with documented controls and incident reporting.

clauses.title: ICT governance
clauses.requirementText: Establish ICT governance and security policies approved by the board.

clauses.title: Data protection and backup
clauses.requirementText: Protect contributor data and maintain tested backups.

clauses.title: Incident reporting
clauses.requirementText: Report material ICT incidents to the Commission.

clauses.title: BVN data confidentiality
clauses.requirementText: Restrict access to BVN data to authorised staff and approved purposes.

clauses.title: BVN access logging
clauses.requirementText: Log and review access to BVN records.

clauses.title: Watch-list obligations
clauses.requirementText: Apply BVN watch-list procedures for fraud-linked identities.

clauses.title: Tax returns e-filing
clauses.requirementText: File applicable tax returns through the FIRS e-filing platform by statutory due dates.

clauses.title: Withholding tax and VAT remittance
clauses.requirementText: Deduct and remit withholding tax and VAT by the due dates with supporting schedules.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Information Security Management Systems — Annex A

clauses.title: Policies for information security
clauses.requirementText: Define, approve, publish and periodically review information security policies.

clauses.title: Information security roles and responsibilities
clauses.requirementText: Define and allocate information security roles and responsibilities.

clauses.title: Access control
clauses.requirementText: Establish and implement rules to control physical and logical access based on business and security requirements.

clauses.title: Identity management
clauses.requirementText: Manage the full lifecycle of identities, including joiners, movers and leavers.

clauses.title: Authentication information
clauses.requirementText: Control the allocation and management of authentication information.

clauses.title: Access rights
clauses.requirementText: Provision, review, modify and remove access rights in line with access control policy; review rights periodically.

clauses.title: Information security in supplier relationships
clauses.requirementText: Define processes to manage security risks arising from the use of supplier products and services.

clauses.title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
clauses.requirementText: Agree relevant security requirements with each supplier in contract.

clauses.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
clauses.requirementText: Manage security risks associated with the ICT product and service supply chain.

clauses.title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
clauses.requirementText: Regularly monitor, review, evaluate and manage change in supplier security practices and service delivery.

clauses.title: Information security for use of cloud services
clauses.requirementText: Define processes for acquiring, using, managing and exiting cloud services.

clauses.title: Incident management planning and preparation
clauses.requirementText: Plan and prepare for incident management by defining processes, roles and responsibilities.

clauses.title: Assessment and decision on information security events
clauses.requirementText: Assess security events and decide whether to categorise them as incidents.

clauses.title: Response to information security incidents
clauses.requirementText: Respond to incidents in accordance with documented procedures.

clauses.title: Learning from information security incidents
clauses.requirementText: Use knowledge from incidents to strengthen and improve controls.

clauses.title: Collection of evidence
clauses.requirementText: Establish procedures for identifying, collecting, acquiring and preserving evidence related to security events.

clauses.title: Information security during disruption
clauses.requirementText: Plan how to maintain security at an appropriate level during disruption.

clauses.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
clauses.requirementText: Plan, implement, maintain and test ICT readiness based on continuity objectives.

clauses.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
clauses.requirementText: Identify, document and keep up to date applicable legal, regulatory and contractual requirements.

clauses.title: Privacy and protection of PII
clauses.requirementText: Identify and meet requirements for preserving privacy and protecting personal data.

clauses.title: Independent review of information security
clauses.requirementText: Review the approach to managing information security independently at planned intervals.

clauses.title: Documented operating procedures
clauses.requirementText: Document operating procedures for information processing facilities and make them available to personnel who need them.

clauses.title: Information security awareness, education and training
clauses.requirementText: Provide personnel with appropriate security awareness, education and training.

clauses.title: Privileged access rights
clauses.requirementText: Restrict and manage the allocation and use of privileged access rights.

clauses.title: Secure authentication
clauses.requirementText: Implement secure authentication technologies and procedures based on access restrictions.

clauses.title: Protection against malware
clauses.requirementText: Implement protection against malware supported by user awareness.

clauses.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
clauses.requirementText: Obtain information on technical vulnerabilities, evaluate exposure and take appropriate measures.

clauses.title: Configuration management
clauses.requirementText: Establish, document, implement, monitor and review configurations, including security configurations.

clauses.title: Information backup
clauses.requirementText: Maintain backup copies of information, software and systems and test them regularly.

clauses.title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
clauses.requirementText: Implement sufficient redundancy to meet availability requirements.

clauses.title: Logging
clauses.requirementText: Produce, store, protect and analyse logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events.

clauses.title: Monitoring activities
clauses.requirementText: Monitor networks, systems and applications for anomalous behaviour and take action on potential incidents.

clauses.title: Use of cryptography
clauses.requirementText: Define and implement rules for effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management.

clauses.title: Change management
clauses.requirementText: Subject changes to information processing facilities and systems to change management procedures.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 27002:2022 Information Security Controls — Implementation Guidance

clauses.title: Access rights — guidance
clauses.requirementText: Guidance on provisioning, periodic review and timely revocation of access rights.

clauses.title: Technical vulnerabilities — guidance
clauses.requirementText: Guidance on vulnerability identification, risk evaluation, patching and verification.

clauses.title: Configuration management — guidance
clauses.requirementText: Guidance on templates, hardening, recording and monitoring configurations.

clauses.title: Incident response — guidance
clauses.requirementText: Guidance on containment, escalation, communication and evidence handling during incidents.

clauses.title: Business impact analysis and risk assessment
clauses.requirementText: Analyse business impacts and risks to set continuity priorities and recovery objectives.

clauses.title: Business continuity plans and procedures
clauses.requirementText: Establish documented plans and procedures to respond to and recover from disruption.

clauses.title: Exercise programme
clauses.requirementText: Exercise and test continuity procedures at planned intervals and after significant change.

clauses.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
clauses.requirementText: Evaluate continuity performance, including recovery achieved against objectives.

clauses.title: Obligations to PII principals
clauses.requirementText: Determine and meet obligations to data subjects, including handling access and correction requests.

clauses.title: Privacy impact assessment
clauses.requirementText: Assess privacy impact where new or changed processing of PII is planned.

clauses.title: Privacy incident management
clauses.requirementText: Include PII breaches in incident management, including notification obligations.

clauses.title: Govern — Organizational Context
clauses.requirementText: Understand the mission, stakeholder expectations and legal and regulatory requirements surrounding cyber risk.

clauses.title: Govern — Risk Management Strategy
clauses.requirementText: Establish and communicate risk priorities, appetite and assumptions to support operational risk decisions.

clauses.title: Govern — Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management
clauses.requirementText: Identify, assess and manage cyber supply chain risks across the supplier lifecycle.

clauses.title: Supplier risks are assessed and monitored
clauses.requirementText: Understand, record, prioritise, assess, respond to and monitor risks posed by suppliers over the relationship.

clauses.title: Identify — Asset Management
clauses.requirementText: Identify and manage assets consistent with their relative importance to objectives and risk strategy.

clauses.title: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified
clauses.requirementText: Identify, validate and record vulnerabilities in assets.

clauses.title: Protect — Identity Management, Authentication and Access Control
clauses.requirementText: Limit access to assets to authorised users, services and hardware commensurate with assessed risk.

clauses.title: Access permissions are managed and reviewed
clauses.requirementText: Define, manage, enforce and review access permissions incorporating least privilege and separation of duties.

clauses.title: Protect — Data Security
clauses.requirementText: Manage data consistent with risk strategy to protect confidentiality, integrity and availability.

clauses.title: Backups of data are created, protected, maintained and tested
clauses.requirementText: Create, protect, maintain and test backups of data.

clauses.title: Configuration management practices are established and applied
clauses.requirementText: Establish and apply configuration management practices.

clauses.title: Software is maintained, replaced and removed commensurate with risk
clauses.requirementText: Maintain, patch, replace and remove software commensurate with risk.

clauses.title: Detect — Continuous Monitoring
clauses.requirementText: Monitor assets to find anomalies, indicators of compromise and other potentially adverse events.

clauses.title: Detect — Adverse Event Analysis
clauses.requirementText: Analyse anomalies, indicators of compromise and adverse events to characterise them and detect incidents.

clauses.title: Respond — Incident Management
clauses.requirementText: Manage responses to detected cybersecurity incidents.

clauses.title: Internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents
clauses.requirementText: Notify internal and external stakeholders, including regulators, of incidents as required.

clauses.title: Recover — Incident Recovery Plan Execution
clauses.requirementText: Perform restoration activities to ensure availability of affected systems and services.

clauses.title: Recover — Incident Recovery Communication
clauses.requirementText: Coordinate restoration activities with internal and external parties.

frameworks.name: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Security and Privacy Controls

clauses.title: Account Management
clauses.requirementText: Define, create, enable, modify, review, disable and remove system accounts per organisational policy.

clauses.title: Account Management | Disable Accounts
clauses.requirementText: Disable accounts within a defined period when expired, no longer associated with a user, in violation of policy, or inactive.

clauses.title: Least Privilege
clauses.requirementText: Allow only the authorised access needed for users and processes to accomplish assigned tasks.

clauses.title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning
clauses.requirementText: Scan for vulnerabilities at a defined frequency and when new vulnerabilities are identified; analyse and remediate based on risk.

clauses.title: Flaw Remediation
clauses.requirementText: Identify, report and correct system flaws; test and install security-relevant updates within defined timeframes.

clauses.title: Configuration Change Control
clauses.requirementText: Determine, review, approve, document and audit changes to the system.

clauses.title: Configuration Settings
clauses.requirementText: Establish, implement, monitor and document configuration settings; manage approved deviations.

clauses.title: Incident Handling
clauses.requirementText: Implement incident handling covering preparation, detection and analysis, containment, eradication and recovery.

clauses.title: Incident Reporting
clauses.requirementText: Require personnel to report suspected incidents internally within a defined time and report incident information to designated authorities.

clauses.title: Incident Response Plan
clauses.requirementText: Develop, distribute, review and update an incident response plan.

clauses.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
clauses.requirementText: Review and analyse audit records at a defined frequency for indications of inappropriate or unusual activity and report findings.

clauses.title: Audit Record Generation
clauses.requirementText: Provide audit record generation for defined event types on system components.

clauses.title: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management
clauses.requirementText: Establish and manage cryptographic keys in accordance with defined key management requirements.

clauses.title: Cryptographic Protection
clauses.requirementText: Implement the types of cryptography required for each specified cryptographic use.

clauses.title: System Backup
clauses.requirementText: Conduct backups of user and system information and protect their confidentiality, integrity and availability.

clauses.title: System Recovery and Reconstitution
clauses.requirementText: Provide for recovery and reconstitution of the system to a known state within defined time and data-loss objectives.

clauses.title: External System Services
clauses.requirementText: Require external service providers to comply with security requirements and monitor their compliance.

frameworks.name: NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 3 Incident Response Recommendations

clauses.title: Preparation
clauses.requirementText: Prepare people, process and technology to handle incidents before they occur.

clauses.title: Detection and analysis
clauses.requirementText: Detect, validate, prioritise and document potential incidents.

clauses.title: Containment, eradication and recovery
clauses.requirementText: Contain the incident, remove its cause and restore affected systems safely.

clauses.title: Post-incident activity
clauses.requirementText: Conduct lessons-learned reviews and feed improvements back into controls.

frameworks.name: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

clauses.title: System components are configured and managed securely
clauses.requirementText: Develop, apply and maintain configuration standards for all system components, addressing known vulnerabilities and industry hardening guidance.

clauses.title: Cryptographic keys used to protect stored account data are secured
clauses.requirementText: Protect keys used to secure stored account data against disclosure and misuse; restrict access to the fewest custodians.

clauses.title: Key management processes are defined and implemented
clauses.requirementText: Document and implement key-management procedures covering generation, distribution, storage, cryptoperiod rotation, retirement and split knowledge/dual control.

clauses.title: Security vulnerabilities are identified and addressed
clauses.requirementText: Identify new vulnerabilities, rank them by risk and install applicable security patches; critical patches within about one month of release.
clauses.deadlineRule: Critical/high patches within one month of release — verify against the current circular

clauses.title: Access to system components and data is appropriately defined and assigned
clauses.requirementText: Define an access control model and assign access based on job classification and least privilege.

clauses.title: User accounts and access privileges are reviewed
clauses.requirementText: Review all user accounts and related access privileges at least once every six months and address inappropriate access.
clauses.deadlineRule: At least every six months — verify against the current circular

clauses.title: Inactive user accounts are removed or disabled
clauses.requirementText: Remove or disable user accounts that have been inactive for 90 days.
clauses.deadlineRule: Within 90 days of inactivity — verify against the current circular

clauses.title: Audit logs are implemented
clauses.requirementText: Enable audit logs that capture user activity and events needed for detection and forensic analysis.

clauses.title: Audit logs are reviewed
clauses.requirementText: Review security event and critical system logs at least daily to identify anomalies or suspicious activity.
clauses.deadlineRule: Daily review of security logs — verify against the current circular

clauses.title: Failures of critical security controls are detected and responded to
clauses.requirementText: Detect, alert on and promptly respond to failures of critical security control systems.

clauses.title: Vulnerabilities are regularly identified and addressed
clauses.requirementText: Perform internal and external vulnerability scans at least quarterly and after significant change; rescan to confirm remediation.
clauses.deadlineRule: At least quarterly — verify against the current circular

clauses.title: Third-party service provider risk is managed
clauses.requirementText: Maintain a list of service providers, written agreements and a programme to monitor their compliance status at least annually.

clauses.title: Suspected and confirmed security incidents are responded to immediately
clauses.requirementText: Maintain, test annually and execute an incident response plan for suspected or confirmed security incidents.

clauses.title: Logical access security
clauses.requirementText: Implement logical access security over protected information assets.

clauses.title: User registration and authorisation
clauses.requirementText: Register and authorise users before issuing credentials; remove access when no longer required.

clauses.title: Role-based access and least privilege
clauses.requirementText: Authorise, modify and remove access based on roles and least privilege.

clauses.title: Configuration and vulnerability monitoring
clauses.requirementText: Detect configuration changes that introduce vulnerabilities and susceptibilities to newly discovered vulnerabilities.

clauses.title: Security event monitoring
clauses.requirementText: Monitor system components for anomalies indicative of malicious acts or errors.

clauses.title: Incident response
clauses.requirementText: Respond to identified security incidents through a defined response programme.

clauses.title: Change management
clauses.requirementText: Authorise, design, test, approve and implement changes to infrastructure and software.

clauses.title: Manage user identity and logical access
clauses.requirementText: Ensure users have access rights according to business need and that rights are reviewed and revoked appropriately.

clauses.title: Manage vulnerabilities and monitor infrastructure for security events
clauses.requirementText: Monitor infrastructure and remediate vulnerabilities to detect and respond to security events.

clauses.title: Managed continuity
clauses.requirementText: Establish and maintain a plan to continue critical business and IT operations through disruption.

clauses.title: Managed business process controls
clauses.requirementText: Define and operate business process controls to ensure information integrity and security.

clauses.title: Managed IT changes
clauses.requirementText: Manage all changes in a controlled manner, including standard and emergency changes.

clauses.title: Manage emergency changes
clauses.requirementText: Carefully manage emergency changes to minimise further incidents and ensure they are controlled and documented after the fact.

clauses.title: Managed configuration
clauses.requirementText: Define and maintain descriptions and relationships of key resources and capabilities and audit configuration repositories.

clauses.title: Managed vendors
clauses.requirementText: Manage IT-related services from all types of vendors, including risk and performance.

clauses.title: Managed compliance with external requirements
clauses.requirementText: Evaluate that IT processes comply with laws, regulations and contractual requirements.

frameworks.name: CIS Critical Security Controls v8 / CIS Benchmarks

clauses.title: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
clauses.requirementText: Actively manage all enterprise assets connected to the infrastructure so only authorised assets have access.

clauses.title: Data Protection
clauses.requirementText: Develop processes and technical controls to identify, classify, securely handle, retain and dispose of data.

clauses.title: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
clauses.requirementText: Establish and maintain secure configuration of enterprise assets and software.

clauses.title: Account Management
clauses.requirementText: Use processes and tools to assign and manage credentials for user, administrator and service accounts.

clauses.title: Disable Dormant Accounts
clauses.requirementText: Delete or disable dormant accounts after a defined period of inactivity (45 days is the suggested benchmark).

clauses.title: Access Control Management
clauses.requirementText: Create, assign, manage and revoke access credentials and privileges for accounts.

clauses.title: Continuous Vulnerability Management
clauses.requirementText: Continuously assess and track vulnerabilities and remediate them to minimise the window of opportunity for attackers.

clauses.title: Audit Log Management
clauses.requirementText: Collect, alert on, review and retain audit logs of events that could help detect, understand or recover from an attack.

clauses.title: Conduct Audit Log Reviews
clauses.requirementText: Review audit logs at least weekly to detect anomalies or abnormal events.
clauses.deadlineRule: At least weekly — verify against the current circular

clauses.title: Data Recovery
clauses.requirementText: Establish and maintain data recovery practices sufficient to restore in-scope assets to a trusted state.

clauses.title: Service Provider Management
clauses.requirementText: Evaluate service providers holding sensitive data or responsible for critical platforms.

clauses.title: Incident Response Management
clauses.requirementText: Establish a programme to prepare, detect and quickly respond to an attack.

clauses.title: Principles relating to processing
clauses.requirementText: Process personal data lawfully, fairly, transparently, for limited purposes, minimally, accurately and securely.

clauses.title: Right of access by the data subject
clauses.requirementText: Give data subjects confirmation of processing, a copy of their data and related information.
clauses.deadlineRule: Respond within one month, extendable in limited cases — verify against the current circular

clauses.title: Processor
clauses.requirementText: Use only processors providing sufficient guarantees, under a binding contract.

clauses.title: Records of processing activities
clauses.requirementText: Maintain records of processing activities.

clauses.title: Security of processing
clauses.requirementText: Implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to secure processing.

clauses.title: Notification of a personal data breach to the supervisory authority
clauses.requirementText: Notify the supervisory authority without undue delay and where feasible within 72 hours of becoming aware of a breach.
clauses.deadlineRule: Within 72 hours from awareness — verify against the current circular

clauses.title: Communication of a personal data breach to the data subject
clauses.requirementText: Inform data subjects without undue delay when a breach is likely to result in high risk to them.

clauses.title: Data protection impact assessment
clauses.requirementText: Assess the impact of high-risk processing before it starts.

frameworks.name: SWIFT Customer Security Programme — Customer Security Controls Framework

clauses.title: SWIFT environment protection
clauses.requirementText: Segregate the local SWIFT infrastructure from the wider IT environment.

clauses.title: Security updates
clauses.requirementText: Apply vendor security updates to SWIFT-related components promptly.

clauses.title: Logical access control
clauses.requirementText: Enforce least privilege, need-to-know and separation of duties for SWIFT operator accounts.

clauses.title: Logging and monitoring
clauses.requirementText: Record and monitor security events on the local SWIFT infrastructure.

clauses.title: Cyber incident response planning
clauses.requirementText: Maintain a cyber incident response plan that covers SWIFT-related incidents.

frameworks.name: Basel III Operational Risk and BCBS 239

clauses.title: Operational loss data collection
clauses.requirementText: Collect and maintain comprehensive internal loss event data.

clauses.title: Accuracy and integrity of risk data
clauses.requirementText: Generate accurate and reliable risk data, largely automated, to minimise error.

clauses.title: Timeliness of risk reporting
clauses.requirementText: Produce aggregate risk data in a timely manner, including under stress.

clauses.title: Selects and develops control activities
clauses.requirementText: Select and develop control activities that mitigate risks to acceptable levels.

clauses.title: Deploys through policies and procedures
clauses.requirementText: Deploy control activities through policies and documented procedures.

clauses.title: Conducts ongoing and separate evaluations
clauses.requirementText: Evaluate whether components of internal control are present and functioning.

clauses.title: Gathering information for analysis and evaluation
clauses.requirementText: Gather relevant, reliable and sufficient information to support engagement conclusions.

clauses.title: Engagement documentation
clauses.requirementText: Document information and evidence to support engagement results and allow review.
